questions.subject: Hausa
questions.learningObjective: Haɗa zantuka biyu ta yadda saɓanin da ke tsakaninsu zai fito fili.
questions.prompt: A haɗa zantukan nan cikin jumla ɗaya mai nuna saɓani: “An buɗe ɗakin karatu.” “Ba a kunna fitilun ɗakin ba.” A ja layi a ƙarƙashin kalmar haɗi sannan a bayyana abin da ta nuna.
questions.answer: An buɗe ɗakin karatu, amma ba a kunna fitilun ɗakin ba. Kalmar haɗi ita ce “amma”. Tana nuna saɓani tsakanin buɗe ɗakin da rashin kunna fitilunsa.
questions.explanation: “Amma” ta haɗa zantukan biyu tare da nuna cewa buɗe ɗakin bai zo da kunna fitilu ba.

markingGuide.description: A kiyaye bayanin cewa an buɗe ɗakin.
A yi amfani da amma a matsayin kalmar haɗi kuma a nuna ta.
A bayyana saɓanin da haɗin ya nuna.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.learningObjective: Gina tambaya mai ba da hanyoyi biyu a matsayin zaɓi.
questions.prompt: Kwamitin aji yana son zaɓar wurin baje kolin littattafai. Wuri na farko shi ne harabar makaranta, na biyu kuma zauren taro. A rubuta tambaya guda da ke gabatar da wuraren biyu a matsayin zaɓi. A bayyana aikin “ko” a tambayar.
questions.answer: Za mu yi baje kolin littattafan a harabar makaranta ko a zauren taro? “Ko” ta raba wuraren biyu a matsayin hanyoyin da kwamitin zai zaɓa daga cikinsu.
questions.explanation: Tambayar tana gabatar da wurare biyu don a zaɓi ɗaya. Za a karɓi wata tambaya mai ma’ana wadda ta kiyaye wuraren biyu.

markingGuide.description: A rubuta tambaya guda mai ma’ana.
A ambaci harabar makaranta da zauren taro.
A yi amfani da ko don nuna zaɓi kuma a bayyana aikinta.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.learningObjective: Gano ayyukan da aka jera da kuma mai yin su a cikin jumla.
questions.prompt: Karanta: “Hauwa ta wanke kwanon, ta goge shi, ta ajiye shi a kan teburi.” A ware ayyukan uku bisa jerinsu. Wace kalma ce ta nuna cewa Hauwa ce ta ci gaba da aikata sauran ayyukan?
questions.answer: Da farko Hauwa ta wanke kwanon. Sai ta goge shi. Daga baya ta ajiye shi a kan teburi. “Ta” a gaban “goge” da “ajiye” tana komawa ga Hauwa.
questions.explanation: Ba a sake rubuta sunan Hauwa a kowane sashe ba. Wakilin suna “ta” ya nuna cewa mai yin ayyukan ɗaya ce.

markingGuide.description: A ba da wanke kwano a matsayin aiki na farko.
A ba da goge kwano a matsayin aiki na biyu.
A ba da ajiye kwano a kan teburi a matsayin aiki na uku.
A nuna cewa ta tana komawa ga Hauwa.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.learningObjective: Rarrabe bayanau nanatau masu bayyana lokaci da wuri cikin zance.
questions.prompt: Duba jimlolin nan: “Mai gadi ya buɗe ƙofa sassafe.” “Yara sun ajiye kujerunsu kusa-kusa a ƙarƙashin inuwa.” A fitar da bayanau nanatau daga kowace jumla. Wanne ya bayyana lokaci, wanne kuma ya bayyana wuri?
questions.answer: “Sassafe” ya bayyana lokacin da aka buɗe ƙofar. “Kusa-kusa” ya nuna matsayin kujerun dangane da juna.
questions.explanation: Sassafe yana amsa tambayar yaushe. Kusa-kusa yana bayyana kusancin kujerun da aka ajiye.

markingGuide.description: A haɗa sassafe da lokacin buɗe ƙofa.
A bayyana matsayin kujerun dangane da juna.
